name: Jeeter | 1g Premium Diamonds Disposable | The Nectar (Seasonal)
description:
The Nectar captures the slower side of summer. Juicy peach and tart raspberry come together in a flavor profile that feels effortless and easygoing from the very first inhale.

A bright raspberry pop leads the way before soft nectarine sweetness settles in, creating a smooth, balanced finish that lingers just enough. Whether it's a sunset on the beach, a backyard gathering, or a quiet evening outdoors, The Nectar was made for the moments when the day begins to slow down and the best part of summer is just getting started.
